Proposition
[Self-Dual and Anti-Self-Dual 2-Forms on $\mathbb R^4$]

↗ prop:hodge-star-euclidean-pair ↗ prop:self-dual-decomposition

1. ch2:2-20

The self-dual forms are $e^0\wedge e^1+e^2\wedge e^3$, $e^0\wedge e^2-e^1\wedge e^3$, and $e^0\wedge e^3+e^1\wedge e^2$; the anti-self-dual forms have the corresponding opposite signs.
Proof

↗ prop:hodge-star-euclidean-pair ↗ prop:self-dual-decomposition \sketch Apply the six coordinate star identities termwise.

□
